AtEntry.description:
One `[at.<name>]` entry: a project when `include` is one literal path,
else a set.

board.description: This entry's board, over `[board]` key by key.

exclude.description: The same forms as `include`, whose matches leave the set.

forks.description:
Whether a glob's linked git worktrees join the set: `false`, the
default, keeps them out, `true` lists them beside their main checkouts,
and `"only"` lists them alone.

BoardColumn.description: One `[[board.columns]]` entry. It sets exactly one of `filter` and `top`.

fallback.description:
The filter to use instead when the project lacks a view the column's
filter names.

filter.description: A filter whose matching tasks the cell counts.

name.description: The column's name, which `sort` and `hide` read it by.

top.description: A filter whose first task, in the project's default order, is the cell.

BoardSpec.description: One board layer as written: each key overrides the layer below it.

hide.description:
An expression over the cells; a row it holds for is hidden. Empty hides
nothing.

sort.description:
Row order: `column`, `column:asc` or `column:desc`, ties broken by
the next entry and then by set order.

description: Schema for `at.toml` in the Mindtape config directory. It names the projects and sets a leading `@name` selects, and the board a bare `mt @name` shows.

at.description: The projects and sets, by the name `@name` selects.

board.description: The board every entry shows, over the shipped board key by key.

title: Mindtape projects and sets
